tasks.title: Crop rebalance (3-day minimum) + 18-crop seasonal roster (5/season + 3 any-season)
tasks.notes: New work per user request (2026-09-01): rebalanced ALL crop growth times to a hard design rule -- every growth stage >=1 in-game day (1440 min), fastest crop overall >=3 in-game days. Old fastest was jasmine_rice at 120min/stage (~2.25hrs total); now 4 days. Durian remains the longest at 6 days. Designed 14 NEW crop types to complete a 5-per-season + 3-any-season roster (existing jasmine_rice/lotus_root/thai_basil/pandan counted toward their buckets): hot=chili/sesame/peanut/sugarcane/watermelon, monsoon=water_spinach/taro/ginger (+existing lotus_root/pandan), cool=cabbage/tomato/garlic/lettuce (+existing thai_basil), any-season=eggplant/yardlong_bean (+existing jasmine_rice). Also replaced thai_basil/pandan/lotus_root's placeholder art (they were reusing rice_paddy_stage*.png verbatim, or in lotus_root's case the whole lotus_maze.png tileset image as a single 'stage sprite' -- a real mismatch) with proper distinct 4-stage sprites. Fixed a total_stages/load_steps mismatch left over from lotus_root's old 2-stage structure. Fixed a stale golden-value assertion in tests/run_tests.gd that hardcoded jasmine_rice's old 120min/stage timing. Per the user's explicit design note, exact grow-time numbers are NOT surfaced as new in-game UI -- crop_bar/crop_label already only show stage X/4, unchanged. IMPORTANT: stage_textures has ZERO visual consumer anywhere in the codebase (verified via grep) -- not even jasmine_rice's growth art renders in-game today. This ships at the same 'data + art ready, engine gap' status as everything else this session; flagged to PO_INBOX. Gates: content 100/100, engine 50/50. Perf gate (y-sort) is RED but for an UNRELATED reason -- opencode's own concurrent 'CookingStation' addition pushed 32->33, not this task's changes (verified by direct node enumeration).

tasks.title: 5 more Thai dishes (Som Tam, Tom Yum, Tom Kha, Gaeng Kua, Larb) from current ingredients only
tasks.notes: New work per user request (2026-09-01): expanded recipes.json from 12->17, deliberately using ONLY already-designed ingredients rather than inventing new crops for missing authentic components. Honest substitutions noted in each description: Som Tam uses cabbage (no papaya vine exists), Tom Yum uses tomato+chili for the sour-hot balance (no lemongrass/galangal/kaffir lime exist), Tom Kha leans on coconut_milk alone (no galangal). Larb kept intentionally meat-free/vegetarian -- the game has zero meat items anywhere (buffalo only ever yields milk) so a meat larb would need a whole new protein system; framed the veg version as the village's own choice, not a placeholder. 2 of 5 (som_tam, tom_yum) depend on fish_sauce/shrimp_paste and are uncraftable until the market gap closes (see PO_INBOX #1, still not landed as of this round). 3 of 5 (tom_kha, gaeng_kua, larb_salad) use only producible/existing ingredients -- fully completable once TASK-043 (planting generalization, already promoted to todo) lands. Gates: content 100/100, engine 50/50.

tasks.notes: User asked to assess protein/meat acquisition. tasks.title: 20-species fish roster: size tiers, season gates, skill tiers, elder hints for rare catches
tasks.notes: User follow-up on the fishing assessment: needed size tiers (small/mid/big), season-gated species, skill-gated rarity, 20 species total, elder hints for hard catches. Designed data/fish/fish.json (new data file, mirrors recipes.json's pattern): 20 real Thai freshwater species (6 common/skill 1, 7 uncommon/skill 2, 5 rare/skill 3, 2 legendary/skill 4 -- pla_buk the Mekong giant catfish and pla_sai_rung a rainbow fish), each with seasons[], rarity, skill_required, and 3 size variants (small/mid/big, harmony_value scaled 0.6x/1.0x/1.6x) = 60 distinct catchable items, all with real programmatically-varied art (5 body shapes: sleek/round/eel/flat/whiskered/prawn). Added a new 'fishing_hint' branch to DialogueDB.gd's existing elder entry (data-only, same safe pattern as the Songkran lines) with all 7 rare+legendary hints. Consolidated the two placeholder fish from the prior round (fish_tilapia/fish_catfish) into pla_nin/pla_duk properly, updated pla_pao's recipe input to match. IMPORTANT: this is pure data + art. The fishing catch mechanic AND a fishing-skill/XP system are both still completely absent from the codebase (confirmed: zero 'skill' references anywhere) -- this compounds the existing PO_INBOX fishing-mechanic ask with a second new system (skill progression) rather than resolving it. Spec'd precisely in PO_INBOX, not guessed at. Gates: content 100/100, engine 50/50.
